general_information.Syllabus Name: 3D Modeling & Shading _ Xây dựng mô hình và tạo chất liệu trong môi trường 3D
general_information.Description: This course covers the fundamentals of creating 3D character UVs, creating textures with Substance Painter, and working with lighting and rendering. Substance Painter is clearly a very powerful texture drawing software. It helps 3D Artists to draw textures in a simpler & more intuitive way based on the available intelligent material inventory Mastering this software also helps 3D Artist understand the properties of each material, thereby easily combining with other 3D software.
general_information.StudentTasks: - Attend at least 80% of contact hours in order to be accepted to the final examination - Actively participate in class activities > - Fulfill tasks given by instructor after class > - Use their own laptop in class only for learning purpose > - Read the textbook in advance > - Access the course website (https://flm.fpt.edu.vn/) for up-to-date information and material of the course.

description: This course covers the fundamentals of creating 3D character UVs, creating textures with Substance Painter, and working with lighting and rendering. Substance Painter is clearly a very powerful texture drawing software. It helps 3D Artists to draw textures in a simpler & more intuitive way based on the available intelligent material inventory Mastering this software also helps 3D Artist understand the properties of each material, thereby easily combining with other 3D software.

learning_outcomes.CLO Details: Students will be able to creating UV.
Students will be able to assign material to the character.
Students will be able to using software Substance Painter.
Students will be able to apply lighting, camera and render a model using Arnold Cinematic render a cartoon scene.
Students can understand Cinematic lighting, and various lighting theories, bring life into character renders and create mood for a render.
Students will be able to create a short clip introducing the characters using light, material and camera.
Students can skills in proficient in presentation and teamwork skills.
